research_value.finding: The observer triggers after committed run_closed and reconstructs only complete passed checked argv executions with exact context and same-path verification.
research_value.practical_consequence: Actions outside governed work-memory plus sequence_checked_exec are invisible.

research_value.finding: Sequence recognition starts only when the model follows advisory skill instructions; guard enforcement begins after explicit selection and activation, and exact identity matching is post-close.
research_value.practical_consequence: The model can improvise before the guard sees an action.

research_value.finding: A complete governed success can auto-bootstrap discovery, but unrecorded success cannot; qualification/promotion is separately invoked and registered matching occurs only after a later run.
research_value.practical_consequence: The passing E2E does not prove autonomous learning or next-time invocation.
research_value.boundary: automatic capture only for checked governed success

research_value.finding: No durable producer binds model self-diagnosis to an action. Blockers and corrections are durable, but reusable content changes only after an explicit bundle edit and successor verification.
research_value.practical_consequence: A wrong action may be cataloged without ever correcting the path used next time.
research_value.boundary: correction verification exists; correction synthesis/canonicalization does not

research_value.finding: Promotion, registered verification, reuse feedback, and correction evidence are durable; registered repair evolves a bundle in one lineage rather than creating an auditable replacement version and atomic cutover.
research_value.practical_consequence: Defective and corrected registered versions are not separately governed selection objects.
research_value.boundary: durable lifecycle without versioned registered repair

research_value.finding: Silver and gold are not canonical states. Discovery-ready, promoted/verified, and post-run registered reuse are only analogues; effectiveness denominators are absent.
research_value.practical_consequence: The system cannot truthfully report silver growth, gold reuse, false matches, or wrong-step recurrence.

research_value.finding: Only checked shell argv has an authoritative action/outcome ledger path. MCP calls, edits, browser actions, subagents, self-reports, and remote model tool actions are absent or aggregate-only.
research_value.practical_consequence: Most model behavior cannot enter the observer.

research_value.finding: Every in-scope action class needs a named authoritative dispatch producer, closed non-secret event, stable identity, outcome binding, and observer consumer; unsupported classes must fail visibly.
research_value.practical_consequence: Universal observation cannot be claimed from checked shell commands alone.
research_value.compatibility: Existing event safety and candidate identity are reusable.

research_value.finding: Exact compatible registered-sequence matching must run before dispatch and require selection, activation, and guard without bypassing approvals.
research_value.practical_consequence: Known correct paths are used before an improvised wrong step occurs.

research_value.finding: No-match successful behavior must create one complete deduplicated canonical discovery only from ordered passed action/outcome evidence.
research_value.practical_consequence: Success paths become reusable without manual reconstruction.

research_value.finding: A model self-diagnosis is a signal, not proof; it must join to exact action, failure, blocker, replacement, and verification evidence or create a typed hold.
research_value.practical_consequence: Unsupported explanations cannot rewrite sequences, but grounded tells are no longer discarded.

research_value.finding: After causal and same-path proof, canonical content must exclude the wrong step and include the corrected step, prerequisites, fingerprint, response, and verification.
research_value.practical_consequence: The next matching task receives the correction or a fail-closed hold, never the known-wrong action.

research_value.finding: Registered repair needs auditable replacement identity, quarantine of the defective version, requalification, verification, and atomic selection cutover.
research_value.practical_consequence: Old defective versions remain auditable but non-selectable.

research_value.finding: Silver and gold need machine-readable entry, promotion, demotion, supersession, and expiry. A grounded base is silver=complete qualified reusable path and gold=registered path proven by governed reuse.
research_value.practical_consequence: Capture and real reuse become distinct measurable stages.

research_value.finding: Metrics need eligible denominators and provenance for matches, silver creation, gold transition, invocation, corrected reuse, duplicates, false matches, evidence holds, and known-wrong recurrence.
research_value.practical_consequence: Progress measures learning effectiveness rather than event volume.

research_value.finding: Stable identity, registered/discovery precedence, collision failure, locking, caps, and suppression must extend across all action and repair producers.
research_value.practical_consequence: Repeated evidence converges on one lineage without backlog churn.

research_value.finding: The full learning loop needs one branch-safe synchronization and resume contract spanning observation, matching, candidate, correction, level, promotion, and reuse.
research_value.practical_consequence: Interruptions and branch divergence cannot lose corrections or duplicate candidates.

research_value.finding: Every new producer must use closed minimal schemas rejecting credentials, personal data, transcripts, hidden reasoning, and raw outputs while preserving safe provenance.
research_value.practical_consequence: The loop learns applicability and causality without accumulating sensitive conversation memory.

research_value.finding: Observation, recommendation, dispatch approval, correction approval, qualification, promotion, registration, and directive authority must remain separate and fail closed.
research_value.practical_consequence: Learning cannot silently execute, approve, or promote.

research_value.finding: Promotion, reuse, correction, quarantine, dismissal, supersession, false-match, and recurrence outcomes must join immutably to identity and be consumed only by declared rule versions.
research_value.practical_consequence: Past outcomes improve recognition without hidden self-tuning.

research_value.finding: Two real-boundary proofs are required: success becomes silver then gold and is selected pre-dispatch; wrong action becomes a verified replacement and is not repeated.
research_value.practical_consequence: Completion is proven by changed next-run behavior, not post-run catalog entries.
